name: io.github.MaksimGalatin/padam-nocturne
title: PADAM · NOCTURNE memory
description: Local-first memory for AI agents: sleep-style consolidation and honest, verifiable forgetting

environmentVariables.name: PADAM_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite memory file. Default: ~/.padam/memory.db

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Local Ollama address for embeddings. Without it a built-in method is used.

environmentVariables.name: PADAM_STRICT
environmentVariables.description: 1 turns on every guard at once: each agent write waits for the owner's review, and switches that weaken protection are ignored.
